text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Takamatsunomiya Kinen, I 
was called over by Agnes Tachyon in the 
corridor outside the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hey, did you drink that concoction?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That "special drink" was a placebo drink 
she made herself. It was actually just 
plain water.
choice_data_list: No, I haven't had anything to drink.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since it claimed to have special effects, 
Calstone Light O refrained from drinking 
it before the race. A wise decision.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I see. Then let me teach you a very 
special curse.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"That drink was just plain water with no 
special effect at all."
choice_data_list:
You're going to spill the truth? Right 
before the show?

You're going to spill the truth? Right 
before the show?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Just try chanting it in front of Right 
O-kun. Trust me on this, just give it a 
shot.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite being told that, time passed 
without me being able to reveal the truth. 
Considering the impact on the race, I 
couldn't say it carelessly.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter, Trainer? You've got a 
face like you've been constipated for a 
week.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O has finally grown 
suspicious of me. It wouldn't be good to 
leave any weird doubts lingering before 
the race.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Did that drink upset your stomach? Please 
feel free to hole up in the restroom. 
Don't hold back.
choice_data_list:
It was just plain water with no effect at 
all!

It was just plain water with no effect at 
all!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Water? Just plain water? Water? Aqua? 
Wasser? JUST PLAIN WATER!?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
What about the "never get tired no matter 
how much you run" effect? What about the 
"better at counterclockwise tracks" 
effect? What about the "double kicking 
power" effect?
choice_data_list: It does NOT have that kind of effect!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: No way...! In that case—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
So all of that was my own ability! Not the 
effect of the drink!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much I run, I don't get 
winded anymore! I've gotten better at 
running counter-clockwise! My kick power 
has doubled!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I can still run my usual race! Even 
without drinking that concoction!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Looks like I'll be beating my top 
speed again today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To think she would interpret it that 
way... What incredible power of 
conviction.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In any case, it looks like she'll show us 
her best run yet today as well.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Good work, Trainer. How was Light O doing?
choice_data_list:
She was so fired up I was worried she'd 
get overexcited.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's wonderful! You seemed a bit 
exhausted lately. If you're full of 
energy, that's all the better!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, there's Durandal over there.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...Just when I thought I was finally 
catching up to the two of them. To be 
stuck stalling like this...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Durandal-san! So you came to watch 
too.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Hello. ...I thought I'd at least come and 
watch.
choice_data_list: You're on a break right now, right...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Although Durandal debuted at the end of 
last year, she went on a break shortly 
after due to concerns about her legs."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I will do what I can right now. Even if it 
is against my wishes, I cannot afford to 
rot away.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Accept the current reality and prepare for 
what lies ahead. I believe I must conduct 
myself as a true knight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Durandal's voice was stiff as she said 
that. Her lips were pressed tightly 
together, as if she were biting back an 
uncontrollable wave of frustration...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Inhaaaale... Exhaaaale...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Focus... The real deal is all in one shot.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Only when you can finish the job there 
without making a single mistake can you 
truly call yourself a pro.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Everything built up until now, right here.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I will perfect it—my running.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The boiling excitement...! Now THIS is a 
GⅠ!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: "A stage to elevate me. And rivals!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Today, too, I shall surpass who I was in 
the past!
